evals.prompt: My ChatQnA deployment starts, but POST /v1/chatqna/chat returns 500. I am using OpenVINO on CPU with Docker Compose. Please troubleshoot and give exact checks and fixes.
evals.expected_output: A runtime-aware troubleshooting flow for Docker OpenVINO: health/model/chat checks, backend and compose logs, likely root causes, and verification commands.
expectations: Uses OpenVINO CPU Docker Compose path and includes source scripts/setup_env.sh.
Includes docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml ps and docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml logs --tail=200 (or similar).
Includes health and chat endpoint checks under /v1/chatqna, including POST /v1/chatqna/chat.
Includes runtime validation checks such as /v1/chatqna/model and /v1/chatqna/devices for OpenVINO.
Provides at least one likely root cause for 500 and a concrete verification command after applying the fix.

evals.prompt: I deployed with Helm and the UI URL does not load. Pods are running in namespace ai-demo. Help me debug and isolate whether this is nginx/service/nodeport related.
evals.expected_output: A Helm troubleshooting sequence using kubectl get/describe/logs plus hostIP/nodePort checks, with a concise diagnosis and corrective action.
expectations: Uses Helm/Kubernetes diagnostics in namespace ai-demo with kubectl get pods and kubectl get svc.
Includes kubectl describe pod and kubectl logs for failing components.
Includes hostIP and nodePort based access checks for nginx/UI path.
Includes endpoint probes for docs or health under /v1/chatqna and reports HTTP status.
Provides a concise nginx/service/nodeport-oriented diagnosis and a corrective action.

evals.prompt: Document upload fails with 400 and sometimes 500 in ChatQnA. Show me how to troubleshoot request format vs backend ingestion/model errors.
evals.expected_output: A document ingestion diagnostic flow validating multipart payload, supported formats, /documents behavior, and log-based root-cause guidance.
expectations: Includes /v1/chatqna/documents checks, including list and upload behavior.
Validates multipart/form-data upload with files field and supported formats such as pdf, txt, or docx.
Differentiates likely 400 causes (request format/payload) from 500 causes (backend ingestion/model/runtime errors).
Includes backend log inspection commands to isolate ingestion or embedding failures.
Provides concrete fix-and-verify steps after identifying the root cause.
